title: Parts, shop supplies and fee or discount lines are unchanged
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service writer on the build under test, with a work order open.
  2. Seed and invoice a work order carrying a parts line, a shop supplies line and a fee or discount line alongside a labor line.
custom_steps:
1. To read the line text a customer/bookkeeper sees: open Export Reports, choose the Customer Invoice report and download it (requires "Invoicing & payments - View"); read the Description column.
  2. Read the parts, shop-supplies and fee/discount lines' text and confirm the title-and-description joining rule does not apply to them.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A parts line, a shop supplies line and a fee or discount line are unaffected: none of them carries a title-and-description pair, so the joining rule does not touch them.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10132 (S3, What Reaches QuickBooks); PRD (Confluence 845348896), Story 3; design board saved_resource(3); read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
